name: omit-zero
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Keys, zero values are omitted.

name: strings
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Scalars. Each value is one clause of the plain or quoted rule, and the reserved words come from 0030's format guards.

name: answers
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Answers. Values follow the domain model's Value kinds, and the names come from the ACME example.

name: unknown-fields
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, Lists, Unknown field values. 0030: unknown fields are preserved.

name: key-order
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: the key order table. Field names are from the domain model.

name: conditions
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Keys, isAnswered. Condition syntax is from docs/reference/section-template-schema/conditions.md.

name: acme
source: The ACME example plan, which is written in canonical form, so the example file is the expected output. The input JSON was first converted from that file with Ruby's YAML loader, then checked and fixed by hand: unknown-yet answers became unknown markers, and a single run string became a one-item list.

name: ambiguous-check
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, ambiguous-check. The domain model says a Check has exactly one of run, ask, or env.
